GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced keenly Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 200m. # didn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was bumped on jumping. Passing the 1200m laid in and had to be eased when awkward on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. 2nd turn 4 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the gelding, rider advised that his mount travelled well until after the 800m, however at this point was not able to quicken with the leader, ran home just fairly in the straight and in his view may not have appreciated the synthetic surface. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn. got split 300 metres. got to front 100 metres. swamped late # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was a little slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 3l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn and dropped out # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding settling further back, rider stated that he anticipated settling forward, however with early speed shown by other runners his mount was unable to hold a forward position. He added that his mount began to over-race near the 1400m when the pace slackened which allowed him to shift rider and stride forward without making use of his mount. He further stated that his mount was overly disappointed in the home straight. Was held up for clear running between the 300m and 200m after being disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down on pace 3 wide. worked to lead 1000 metres. led turn. battled away # worked in run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest re riding, rdr stated she was instr to ride positively and after being caught 3 wide ouside lead in early stages she endeavoured to ease back to try and find cover behind leaders she elected to press fwd to obtain lead which she did app 800m. Stewards advised she should have made that decision earlier in back straight. Trn advised stewards instr were to ride a little more conservatively and he was surprised to see geld race so far fwd.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out drifted back near last 10l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well making good ground # back/ran on strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and from the outside barrier shifted in behind rnrs in the early stages.
